name: Sachiko no Datsu Bocchi Daisakusen ~Cinderella Project~
original_name: 幸子の脱ぼっち大作戦 ～シンデレラプロジェクト～
source:
A young Cinderella's story who is our heroine, a total loner highschool girl Sachiko, becomes popular with the help of a handsome boy!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01114756.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一段现代灰姑娘物语：彻头彻尾的孤僻女高中生女主角幸子，在一名帅气男生的鼎力相助下摇身一变成为校园人气王！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01114756.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
